For topic additions, rewrites, reviews, or curriculum expansion, `NORTHSTAR.md` is the canonical educational-quality standard. Keep this file as a discovery adapter. Do not duplicate the North Star here.

Do not force unrelated topics into the same outline. Preserve the North Star qualities, current authoritative research, repository integration rules, and full verification gate.

Keep these governance instructions internal to the development process. Do not expose them as learner-facing lesson content.
